index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents a hierarchical taxonomy illustrating the scope and structure of a survey on AI-driven smart spaces. At the top center, a blue rectangular box labeled 'AI-driven Smart Spaces' serves as the root node, from which six primary branches extend downward via solid black lines ending in diamond-shaped connectors. These branches represent the core domains: Sensor Technologies (gray), Data Communications (blue), Sensor Network Management (light green), Data Collection & Processing (peach), Artificial Intelligence (light blue), and Large Language Models (lavender). Each domain is represented by a colored rectangular box with bolded text.

Under 'Sensor Technologies', three gray boxes are arranged vertically: 'Environmental Sensors', 'Infrared Sensors', and 'Camera'. A fourth gray box, 'Other Sensing Technologies', is positioned below 'Data Communications' and connected back to 'Sensor Technologies' via a horizontal line with a diamond connector, indicating an alternative or supplementary category.

The 'Data Communications' branch includes two blue boxes: 'Communication Technologies' and 'Communication Protocols', stacked vertically.

'Sensor Network Management' has two light green boxes: 'Network Energy Management' and 'Sensor Operations and Maintenance', also stacked vertically.

'Data Collection & Processing' contains two peach-colored boxes: 'Data Collection and Processing' and 'Data Quality', arranged vertically.

'Artificial Intelligence' branches into three light blue boxes: 'Conventional Machine Learning', 'Deep Learning Models', and 'Transformer Networks', stacked vertically.

'Large Language Models' includes three lavender boxes: 'OpenAI ChatGPT', 'Google BERT', and 'Meta Llama', arranged vertically. From each of these, a horizontal line extends rightward to another lavender box: 'RAG' from ChatGPT, 'Small & Tiny LMs' from BERT, and 'Other LLMs' from Llama. Each connection uses a diamond-shaped connector, suggesting associations or applications.

All connections between boxes are solid black lines with diamond-shaped arrowheads pointing toward child nodes, indicating a hierarchical decomposition. The layout is strictly top-down and left-to-right, with consistent spacing and alignment across columns. The figure uses distinct colors to differentiate major domains and maintains uniform rectangular shapes for all modules. Text within boxes is centered and uses a sans-serif font. No mathematical equations or LaTeX expressions are present in the diagram itself, but the caption indicates it represents the survey's scope and structure.
